Third-party licenses for the Plotly.js gl2d 4.1.2 distribution
================================================================

This file lists the npm package versions whose source modules occur in the
official, unminified Plotly.js gl2d 4.1.2 bundle. It also covers the minified
distribution shipped with tsHtmlApp. Plotly's own license is supplied in
LICENSE-plotly.txt, and notices already embedded in the bundle are preserved.

Package versions and npm tarball integrity values were taken from the exact
Plotly v4.1.2 release package-lock.json. Each tarball was verified against its
recorded integrity hash before license text was extracted. The packages and
license-source records are listed in THIRD-PARTY-PROVENANCE.json.

Where an upstream package declares MIT but supplies no separate license text,
its original author metadata and any README license/copyright notice appear
below, followed by the standard MIT permission and warranty terms. No missing
copyright year has been invented. The canonical MIT terms are reproduced from:
https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/blob/main/text/MIT.txt

Included source distributions: 91 package-version instances, 90 package names.
Each project's authors retain their respective rights. Inclusion does not
imply endorsement of tsHtmlApp by those authors.
